before.name: Giga, Source Adept
before.rules_text:
When played, draw a card.
Exhaust — Dominion: gain 3 mastery.

after.name: Giga, Source Adept
after.rules_text:
When played, draw a card.
Exhaust — Dominion: gain 2 mastery.

giga-mastery.summary: Dominion mastery 3 → 2. Cost 2, defense 4 and draw stay the same.

before.name: Deadly Recruits
before.rules_text:
Exhaust: choose an ally costing 2 or less from the row. Fast-play it OR recruit it for free.
M20: cost 4 or less.

after.name: Deadly Recruits
after.rules_text:
Pay 1 gem, Exhaust: choose an ally costing 2 or less from the row. Fast-play it OR recruit it.
M20: cost 4 or less.

deadly-recruits-cost.summary: Activation costs 1 gem. Both modes and both target-cost limits stay the same.

before.name: Multitask Brain
before.rules_text:
For each different faction you played this turn, gain 2 power and draw a card.
M20: gain 4 power instead of 2.

after.name: Multitask Brain
after.rules_text:
For each different faction you played this turn, gain 1 power and draw a card.
M20: gain 4 power instead of 1.

brain-power.summary: Power per faction 2 → 1 below M20. Drawing and the M20 power tier stay the same.

before.name: Panconscious Crown
before.rules_text:
Gain 2 mastery and 5 health.
M20 Unify: gain 50 health.

after.name: Panconscious Crown
after.rules_text:
Gain 2 mastery, 5 health and draw a card.
M20 Unify: gain 50 health.

crown-draw.summary: Add Draw 1 to the base-effect line; draw before checking M20 Unify.

before.name: Unconditional Conscription
before.rules_text: Exhaust: if you played 2+ non-starter allies costing 2 or less this turn, gain 4 power.

after.name: Unconditional Conscription
after.rules_text: Exhaust: if you played 2+ non-starter allies costing 2 or less this turn, gain 5 power.

conscription-reliability.summary: Conditional power 4 → 5. The existing two-card requirement and eligible cards stay the same.

before.name: Soul Syphon
before.rules_text: Exhaust: if you played cards of 3+ different factions this turn, gain 7 health.

after.name: Soul Syphon
after.rules_text: Exhaust: if you played cards of 2+ different factions this turn, gain 5 health.

soul-syphon-reliability.summary: Require 2 cards spanning 2 factions instead of 3 cards spanning 3 factions; healing 7 → 5.

before.name: Furrowing Elemental
before.rules_text:
Gain 4 health and draw a card.
If you are at 50 health, gain 4 power.

after.name: Furrowing Elemental
after.rules_text:
Gain 4 health and draw a card.
If you are at 50 health, gain 4 power.

furrowing-price.summary: Cost 5 → 4. All effects and the two copies stay the same.

before.name: J-Chord
before.rules_text:
Exhaust — Warp 3.
M15: Warp 6 instead.

after.name: J-Chord
after.rules_text:
Exhaust — Warp 3.
M15: Warp 6 instead.

j-chord-hold.summary: Cost 3 → 4. Defense 3, Warp 3 and M15 Warp 6 stay the same.

before.name: Shard Abstractor
before.rules_text: Gain 2 mastery.

after.name: Shard Abstractor
after.rules_text:
Gain 1 mastery.
M10: gain 2 instead.

abstractor-hold.summary: Cost 3 → 2. Gain 1 mastery; at M10 gain 2 instead. Simplify the printed text.

before.name: Volos — First Aid
before.rules_text:
M5: once per turn, choose one:
— Gain 3 health.
— Pay 1 gem: gain 2 power.
— Pay 2 gems: draw a card.
— Pay 3 gems: gain 1 mastery.

after.name: Volos — First Aid
after.rules_text:
M5: once per turn, choose one:
— Gain 3 health.
— Pay 1 gem: gain 3 power.
— Pay 2 gems: draw a card.
— Pay 3 gems: gain 1 mastery.

hero-powers-hold.summary: Pay 1 gem: gain 3 power instead of 2.

before.name: Order Initiate
before.rules_text: You may remove a card from the shop. Gain 2 gems. Dominion: gain 2 mastery.

after.name: Order Initiate
after.rules_text: You may remove a card from the shop. Gain 2 gems. Dominion: gain 1 mastery.

before.name: Shard Seer
before.rules_text:
Draw a card.
You may reveal an Infinity Shard from your hand to gain 2 mastery.

after.name: Shard Seer
after.rules_text:
Draw a card.
You may reveal an Infinity Shard from your hand to gain 1 mastery.

shard-seer-mastery.summary: Infinity Shard reveal grants 1 mastery instead of 2.

before.name: Duplication Fabricator
before.rules_text:
Gain 1 mastery.
Every player reveals their deck's top card; copy the effect of one revealed ally.
M20: you may copy any number of effects from the revealed cards instead.

after.name: Duplication Fabricator
after.rules_text:
Gain 1 mastery.
Every player reveals their deck's top card; copy the effect of one revealed ally.
M20: you may copy any number of effects from the revealed cards instead.

before.name: Breaker
before.rules_text:
Shield 4.
When you recruit this, it goes to your hand instead of your discard pile.
Warp.

after.name: Breaker
after.rules_text:
Shield 4.
When you recruit this, it goes to your hand instead of your discard pile.
Warp 6.

breaker-warp.summary: Warp is limited to allies costing 6 or less.

before.name: Fungal Hermit
before.rules_text:
Gain 1 mastery.
M10: gain 5 health. Its own mastery gain counts.

after.name: Fungal Hermit
after.rules_text:
Shield 2.
Gain 1 mastery.
M10: gain 5 health. Its own mastery gain counts.

before.name: Ingeminex: Corruption
before.rules_text:
Attack: every player loses 3 health and 1 mastery.
Reward: recruit an additional relic to your hand.

after.name: Ingeminex: Corruption
after.rules_text:
Attack: every player loses 3 health and 1 mastery.
Reward: recruit an additional relic to your hand.

before.name: Omnius, The All-Knowing
before.rules_text:
Draw two cards.
Dominion: gain 5 mastery.

after.name: Omnius, The All-Knowing
after.rules_text:
Draw two cards.
Dominion: gain 3 mastery.

before.name: Systema A.I.
before.rules_text:
Exhaust: gain 1 mastery.
M20: also draw two cards.

after.name: Systema A.I.
after.rules_text:
Exhaust: gain 1 mastery.
M20: also draw two cards.

after.name: Horizon Seeker
after.rules_text:
Draw a card.
If you have less mastery than your opponent, gain 1 mastery.

horizon-seeker.summary: Order ally, cost 2, 2 copies. Draw 1; if behind in mastery, gain 1 mastery.

after.name: Riftbreaker
after.rules_text:
Gain 3 power.
If you have less mastery than your opponent, you may banish a card from your hand or discard pile.

riftbreaker.summary: Wraethe mercenary, cost 2, 2 copies. Gain 3 power; if behind in mastery, you may banish 1 from hand or discard.

after.name: Relief Courier
after.rules_text:
Gain 2 gems.
If you have less mastery than your opponent, gain 4 health.

relief-courier.summary: Undergrowth ally, cost 3, 2 copies. Gain 2 gems; if behind in mastery, gain 4 health.

after.name: Aegis Surveyor
after.rules_text:
Shield 2.
Gain 2 power.
If you have less mastery than your opponent, gain 1 gem.

catchup-card.summary: Homodeus mercenary, cost 1, 2 copies. Shield 2; gain 2 power; if behind in mastery, gain 1 gem.

after.name: Rift Scout
after.rules_text:
Gain 3 power.
If you have less mastery than your opponent, Warp 1.

rift-scout.summary: Aion ally, cost 2, 2 copies. Gain 3 power; if behind in mastery, Warp 1.

before.name: Opening shop
before.rules_text: The initial six shop slots can contain cards of any cost.

after.name: Opening shop
after.rules_text:
Only cards with printed cost 5 or less can occupy the initial six shop slots.
After setup, all costs can appear in refills, even during the first turn.

opening-shop.summary: Initial six slots: printed cost 5 or less. All later refills are unrestricted.

before.name: Champion combat
before.rules_text:
Power attacks against champions are assigned together at the end of the turn.
Testudo shield reactions are also deferred.

after.name: Champion combat
after.rules_text:
Attack enemy champions during your turn, between your other actions.
Resolve each attack before choosing the next action.
Zetta must leave play before protected targets unlock.
Remaining power attacks players at the end of your turn.

champion-combat.summary: Resolve champion attacks during the turn in your chosen order; player damage remains at turn end.

before.name: Testudo Vanguard
before.rules_text:
Your shields are also applied to each of your champions individually.
Exhaust: gain 2 gems.

after.name: Testudo Vanguard
after.rules_text:
Your shields also protect each of your champions.
Each champion has a separate shield allowance per opponent turn; repeated attacks do not refresh it.
Multiple Testudo Vanguards do not multiply this protection.
Exhaust: gain 2 gems.

testudo-shield-timing.summary: Proposed: separate shield allowance per champion per enemy turn; no refresh between hits; losing the last Testudo ends further champion protection.
